statements.t: We have sought and expect to continue to seek to diversify our sales by developing relationships with additional, quality-oriented, private-label contract manufacturing customers, and commercializing our patent estate through sales of beta-alanine under our CarnoSyn®, SR CarnoSyn®, CarnoSyn® 4X and TriBsyn® trademarks, royalties from license agreements, and potentially additional contract manufacturing…
We expect our annualized fiscal 2027 revenue concentration for our largest customer to be lower as compared to our revenue concentration for our largest customer in fiscal 2026.
We believe TriBsyn® and its patent-pending formulation will enable us to better penetrate the Wellness and Healthy Aging market.

We believe our continued efforts to refine our formulations and expand our product portfolio will be well received and create significant opportunities to increase sales of our patented and patent-pending products.

During the remainder of fiscal 2027, we will continue our sales and marketing activities to consumers, customers, potential customers, and brand owners on multiple platforms to promote and reinforce the features and benefits of utilizing CarnoSyn®, SR CarnoSyn®, CarnoSyn® 4X and TriBsyn® beta-alanine products.
We currently anticipate we will experience an increase in net sales for fiscal 2027 as compared fiscal 2026 and return to profitability in our fourth quarter of fiscal 2027.
During the remainder of fiscal 2027, we plan to continue our focus on:

We have advised our lender that we are not in compliance with the covenant as of September 30, 2026 and that we do not expect to be in compliance during our fiscal year 2027 under the current terms of the agreement.

To date, our lender has not indicated they intend to exercise their rights to terminate the credit agreement, and we continue to have full utilization of the credit facility, including ongoing borrowing and repayment activity.
Management has prepared cash flow projections incorporating these plans, as well as projected sales growth reflecting our best estimates of future operating performance and liquidity needs.

While management plans to take the actions noted above, there can be no assurance we will be successful in our efforts to obtain a waiver, amendment, or obtain alternative financing or avoid future issues maintaining compliance with financial covenants.

While unfavorable outcomes are possible, based on available information, we currently do not believe the resolution of these matters, even if unfavorable, will result in a material adverse effect on our business, consolidated financial condition, or results of operations.
Our evaluation of the likely impact of these actions could change in the future, and we could have unfavorable outcomes we do not expect.
Payment was remitted in the first quarter of our fiscal year 2027, and final court approval and termination of the proceedings is expected to take place in February 2027.

During the three -month period ended September 30, 2026 , none of the Company's directors or officers, as defined in Section 16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 adopted or terminated any contract instruction or written plan for the purchase or sale of the Company’s securities that was intended to satisfy the affirmative defense conditions of Rule 10b5 - 1 (c) or any "non-Rule 10b5 - 1 trading arrangement"…
